parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. If you omit this parameter, the default value `en` is used.

- `zh`: Chinese

- `en`: English

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the gateway. This parameter is required for non-serverless instances.

parameters.name: ClbNetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the provisioned pay-by-LCU Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

- `pubnet`: Public Network

- `privatenet`: Private Network

- `privatepubnet`: Public and Private Networks

> For non-serverless instances, you can provision only one of the following load balancer types: a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance, a pay-by-LCU Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance, or a pay-by-specification CLB instance.

> For Serverless instances, you can provision either an NLB instance or a pay-by-LCU CLB instance.

parameters.name: EnableHardwareAcceleration
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable hardware acceleration.

parameters.name: EnableSls
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable log delivery to Simple Log Service (SLS).

parameters.name: EnableXtrace
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Tracing Analysis.

parameters.name: EnterpriseSecurityGroup
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use an Enterprise Security Group.

parameters.name: InternetSlbSpec
parameters.description:
The specifications of the public-facing Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance. This parameter applies to non-serverless instances.

- slb.s1.small

- slb.s2.small

- slb.s2.medium

- slb.s3.small

- slb.s3.medium

- slb.s3.large

> For non-serverless instances, you can provision only one of the following load balancer types: a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance, a pay-by-LCU Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance, or a pay-by-specification CLB instance.

> For Serverless instances, you can provision either an NLB instance or a pay-by-LCU CLB instance.

parameters.name: ManagedEntryNetworkType
parameters.description:
The ingress type of the gateway. This parameter applies only to Professional Edition instances.

- `pubnet`: Public Network

- `privatenet`: Private Network

- `privatepubnet`: Public and Private Networks

parameters.name: MserVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of the gateway.

- `mse_premium`: Professional Edition

- `mse_pro`: Standard Edition

- `mse_serverless`: Serverless Edition

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the gateway.

parameters.name: NlbNetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type of the provisioned Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

- `pubnet`: Public Network

- `privatenet`: Private Network

- `privatepubnet`: Public and Private Networks

> For non-serverless instances, you can provision only one of the following load balancer types: a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance, a pay-by-LCU Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance, or a pay-by-specification CLB instance.

> For Serverless instances, you can provision either an NLB instance or a pay-by-LCU CLB instance.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the gateway is deployed.

parameters.name: Replica
parameters.description: The number of gateway nodes. This parameter is required for non-serverless instances.

parameters.name: RequestPars
parameters.description: The extended request parameters, in JSON format.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Resource Group.

parameters.name: SlbSpec
parameters.description:
The specifications of the internal-facing Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance. This parameter applies to non-serverless instances.

- slb.s1.small

- slb.s2.small

- slb.s2.medium

- slb.s3.small

- slb.s3.medium

- slb.s3.large

> For non-serverless instances, you can provision only one of the following load balancer types: a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance, a pay-by-LCU Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance, or a pay-by-specification CLB instance.

> For Serverless instances, you can provision either an NLB instance or a pay-by-LCU CLB instance.

parameters.name: Spec
parameters.description:
The instance type of the gateway. This parameter is required for non-serverless instances.

- MSE\_GTW\_16\_32\_200\_c (16 Cores 32 GB)

- MSE\_GTW\_2\_4\_200\_c (2 Cores 4 GB)

- MSE\_GTW\_4\_8\_200\_c (4 Cores 8 GB)

- MSE\_GTW\_8\_16\_200\_c (8 Cores 16 GB)

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: An array of tags to add to the gateway.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary vSwitch. This parameter is required for single-zone deployments.

parameters.name: VSwitchId2
parameters.description: The ID of the secondary vSwitch. This parameter is required for multi-zone deployments.

parameters.name: Vpc
parameters.description: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: XtraceRatio
parameters.description: The sampling rate for Tracing Analysis. Valid values are integers from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ZoneInfo
parameters.description: The zone information. This parameter is required for multi-zone deployments.
